• Market entry relies heavily on convincing procurement teams and brands; the plan for initial outreach is stated but not detailed.
• The 'explore' language used for several features (witness network, verification widget, machine-readable ledger) suggests the final product and go-to-market strategy are still in formative stages.

**Project B Pros:**

**Project B Cons:**

• The added communication element is minor and does not fundamentally alter the core business model or address other potential cons.

**Overall Winner:** Project B wins. The projects are virtually identical, but Project B demonstrates a marginally more comprehensive and user-aware approach by explicitly planning to demystify its core technology for its target audience. This small addition shows greater operational foresight regarding a key adoption hurdle.
